SITE_NAME.description: Display name for this community's instance (e.g. 'Go Stop Saillans!')

SERVICE_TZ.description: IANA timezone for the community (e.g. Europe/Paris, Europe/London). Used to interpret time-only searches correctly.

RIDE_GRACE_MINUTES.description: Minutes after a ride's flex window closes before it disappears from search results (default: 60)

INBOX_REMINDER_INTERVAL_HOURS.description: Hours between reminder pushes for unread contact requests, accepted requests, shared numbers and contact offers, and (at most 2 reminders) matching rides and the post-ride prompt (default: 3)

INBOX_REMINDER_QUIET_HOURS.description: Local hours with no reminder pushes, e.g. 21-8 (default); 'none' to always send

MORNING_DIGEST_HOUR.description: Local hour of the daily morning digest of today's rides and requests (default: 8); 'none' to disable

NOTIFICATION_RETENTION_DAYS.description: Max days a notification stays in the in-app inbox (default: 30); removed earlier when its ride or request expires or is deleted

RETURN_DELAY_HOURS.description: Default hours after outbound departure to pre-fill the return trip time (default: 2)
